channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Check Point
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Check Point, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch: Check Point (multiple products): Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
item.description:
Check Point (multiple products): exploited from day 0 · fix: R81.20

First step: Update the affected Check Point products to R81.20 or later.

Check Point Firewall, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Scalable Platforms, Security Gateway, and Security Management Server contain an incorrect permissions assignment for critical resources vulnerability when the Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket without authenticating connecting processes. An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-123039

item.title: Patch: Actively Exploited Privilege Escalation and Critical PHP Vulnerabilities in Check Point Products
item.description:
Check Point Products: Privilege escalation · exploited · fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for Check Point Products. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

Critical · Fix available
